target: bypass the apparent 2^t strong-backdoor branch product on the R44F family

machine.recognizer: Build the variable-cooccurrence graph of the CNF and compute connected components.
machine.exact_law: If F = AND_i F_i and Var(F_i) are pairwise disjoint, then SAT(F) iff AND_i SAT(F_i). SAT witnesses concatenate because assignments have disjoint domains; UNSAT of any component implies UNSAT of F.
machine.cost: Graph construction plus connected-components plus the sum of component solver costs. No Cartesian product of component branch assignments is enumerated.
machine.compression: For t disjoint copies of one constant-size gadget, solve t local components independently instead of enumerating 2^t global backdoor assignments.

claim_for_R44F_family.total_route_work: O(t) up to fixed local solver constants
